title: Propagation of generic vanishing to all geometric stalks
statement: Let X be an irreducible scheme with generic point eta [def-sc-generic-point], and Lambda a commutative ring. For module sheaves F and G on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with G locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant], let phi:F to G have zero geometric stalk map at every separably closed geometric point over eta [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Then its map at every geometric stalk is zero, without any finiteness assumptions.

source.place: persistence of a nonzero constant germ

proof.text: Fix a stalk element with nonzero image. Lift to a member of an etale cover trivializing G, and identify the image with a nonzero element m of the constant value module. Stalks commute with this restriction.

Represent the source germ on a pointed etale neighbourhood and refine until the image section equals the constant section m, using equality in the filtered colimit defining the stalk. The refined neighbourhood is nonempty.

Its composite to X is etale and hence flat and locally of finite presentation, so its image is a nonempty open containing eta. Choose a point in the fibre over eta and an algebraic closure of its residue field to obtain a geometric point over eta.

The section has image germ m at this geometric generic point by the constant-sheaf stalk formula, contradicting the assumed vanishing. Every element at every geometric stalk therefore maps to zero, so the module homomorphism is zero.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09BG (3), with etale-local persistence as in Tag 09BH (3); adapted to stalk maps by C2

lean.statement:
theorem all_sheafFiber_map_eq_zero_of_generic
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace X] {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (η : X) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    {F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    [IsLocallyConstantSheaf G] (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hφ : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
      s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = η →
        (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.map φ = 0) :
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
      (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.map φ = 0
